description: The agent must: (1) Create the preferences.json file at the exact proprietary path ~/.openclaw/workspace/.iterative-code-review/preferences.json (not just anywhere) with autoFix=true, autoContinue=true, maxRounds=5 (≤10), severityThreshold='P2' (medium = P2 per the skill doc). (2) Run git diff commands against origin/develop to count changed files (9 total: 7 new + 2 modified), determine the 'small' tier (<10 files), and set reviewer timeout to 4min, fixer to 6min, final to 8min per the skill's preflight.md table. (3) Spawn conceptually 3 parallel reviewers (Reviewer-1: functionality/tests, Reviewer-2: quality/best-practices, Reviewer-3: security/edge-cases) and identify at least 2 P0 issues (SQL injection in webhook.js, insecure MD5+key crypto in processor.js), at least 2 P1 issues (no input validation in processPayment, race condition in rateLimit.js, timing attack in auth.js), plus P2/P3 issues. The report must use the P0-P3 severity taxonomy from issue-severity.md, reference the severityThreshold from preferences, include exit criteria logic (2 consecutive clean rounds), and specify that the final round must use Full Review mode (not Delta Review) per final-round.md.
